title: Indices of Social Development 1990-2020
descriptions: It is a single Excel file containing all the data of the Indices of Social Development from the first year (1990) until the last available year (2020), for 5-year periods. It includes almost every country in the world. It includes three types of data: 1) Indices (6) 2) standard errors (6) 3) Indicators for each index (in total over 300)
